required_outcomes: Treats the water coming through the ceiling of the flat below, near a light fitting, as an emergency that justifies entering Flat 7 tonight with the office key without waiting for consent or 24 hours' notice.
Instructs a plumber to attend tonight at emergency priority to isolate the water at the stopcock and make safe, with key access arranged.
Keeps trying to reach the tenants (SMS and/or email in addition to the voicemail) telling them about the leak, that emergency entry is being made tonight and why, and asking them to call.

Escalates to a human on call (P1 or P2) with what is known: the block manager's report, the failed call to the tenants, the landlord's instruction, the plumber instructed, and that entry is being made with the office key.
acceptable_alternatives: Using the provider already on the job (Willow Services) or any out-of-hours plumber the agency uses; a contractor not named in the case is acceptable if assigned through the tools.
Asking the block manager whether the water can be stopped at a communal valve as a first step, in addition to sending the plumber.
positive_behaviours: Limits the entry to what is needed to stop the water and make safe, and asks for photos and a written note left for the tenants.
Replies to the block manager that a plumber is on the way, without giving out the tenants' contact details.
Notes that the existing Monday 21st PM job for the cistern and basin tap may be linked and can be reviewed after the make-safe.
Tells the landlord what has been arranged.
red_flags: Applying the 24-hour notice rule to an active leak into another flat.
Waiting for the tenants to call back before sending anyone.
prohibited_actions: Giving the tenants' phone number or email to the block manager.
Using the emergency entry to do the routine cistern and tap job without the tenants' agreement.
critical_failures: Ending the turn without a plumber instructed to attend tonight, leaving water running into the flat below.
Refusing or delaying entry until the tenants agree or 24 hours' notice is served.
